name: High frequency noise re-entry at upscale (H3)
plain: After spatially resizing video latents, adds fresh noise containing only frequencies above the previous resolution, scaled by RMS, so upscale stages do not lack high-frequency energy. Keeps old low frequencies untouched by construction.

family_fit.why: file and node names target H3
family_fit.label: from code

label: from code

audit.note: "Only frequencies above the previous resolution" and "by construction" overclaim. low is trilinear down then up (IAMCCS__IAMCCS-nodes/iamccs_minimax_h3_progressive_spatial.py:103-113, 165-167), not an ideal low-pass, so high keeps some lower-frequency energy and leaked content. It is approximately high-pass. rms is global over the tensor. No-op if gain≤0 or σ≤0.
